21.    CONSIDERATION OF BIDS/PURCHASES/REQUESTS FOR PROPOSALS:

                (Revenue to the City)

Dr. Rinnc moved to accept the bid from Black Rain Ordnance, Inc., in an amount not to exceed

Sergeant Kevin Malatesta, Police Department, provided a staff report and committee member
Moody commented on the item.

       g)       Consideration of Bid #E—1 0—26 for furnishing Three (3) new Fairway Mowers for
                the City of Cheyenne Golf Division. (Golf Fund)
